sourceChecks.text: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:3で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:5で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:7で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:8で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:9で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:10で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:12で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA10:16で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA10:19で本文がハダデゼルを名指す。
